adjust_grenades.description: Modifies a player's grenade count by type using a math operation.

apply_player_traits.description: Applies a named `player_traits` block to a player.

begin.description: Marks the start of a nested sub-trigger block. While `begin` is technically an action, the language treats it more like an element. See the begin element page for more information.

biped_drop_weapon.description: Drops a weapon from a biped/player.

biped_give_weapon.description: Gives a weapon to a biped/player.

boundary_set_player_color.description: Sets boundary tint color for a player.

boundary_set_visible.description: Shows or hides a boundary volume.

break_into_debugger.description: Breaks into the script debugger when tracing is enabled.

create_object.description: Spawns an object of the given type at a reference object, with optional filter, flags, and offset.

create_tunnel.description: Places an object between two entities and gives that object a **cylinder** shape. The radius comes from the radius operand; if that value is **0**, the engine uses **5** instead. If both endpoints are the same object, the tunnel is placed **exactly** on that reference—there is no collision check, unlike create_object. The spawned object also faces straight up.

debug_force_player_view_count.description: Debug action to force player view count.

debugging_enable_tracing.description: Enables or disables script tracing in the debugger.

delete_object.description: Removes an object reference from the map.

device_animate_position.description: Animates a device between positions over time.

device_get_position.description: Reads device position into an out-variable.

device_get_power.description: Reads device power into an out-variable.

device_set_position_immediate.description: Snaps a device to a position without animation.

device_set_position_track.description: Assigns an animation track name to a device.

for_each.description: Iterates over players, teams, or objects and runs nested trigger logic.

game_grief_record_custom_penalty.description: Records a custom grief report penalty value.

get_button_time.description: Reads how long a scriptable button was held into a custom variable, in milliseconds (Reach MCC only).

get_player_holding_object.description: Writes the player holding an object into an out-variable.

get_random_object.description: Selects a random object matching criteria and writes it to an out-variable.

hide_object.description: Hides or shows an object for players (Reach MCC only).

hs_function_call.description: Calls a HaloScript function by index (Reach MCC only).

hud_post_message.description: Posts a HUD message to a team or player target. The sound operand selects an e_megalo_sound token or `none`. The message is a dynamic string.

hud_widget_set_icon.description: Sets the icon on a HUD widget.

hud_widget_set_meter.description: Configures meter parameters on a HUD widget.

hud_widget_set_text.description: Updates text on a named HUD widget using a dynamic string.

hud_widget_set_value.description: Updates a numeric value displayed on a HUD widget using a dynamic string.

hud_widget_set_visibility.description: Shows or hides a HUD widget for a player reference.

navpoint_set_icon.description: Sets the navpoint icon displayed above an object. The ME name table ends with `coop spawning` (space). MegaloEdit cannot parse it (Megalo Headache #3); enable MegaCrow’s `coopSpawning` extension to accept the two-token form.

navpoint_set_text.description: Sets navpoint label text from a dynamic string.

navpoint_set_timer.description: Links a navpoint to a timer for countdown display.

navpoint_set_visible_range.description: Sets the distance at which a navpoint becomes visible.

navpoint_set_visible.description: Controls navpoint visibility for a target audience (everyone, team, player, etc.).

object_adjust_health.description: Modifies an object's current health with a math operation.

object_adjust_maximum_health.description: Modifies an object's maximum health with a math operation.

object_adjust_maximum_shield.description: Modifies an object's maximum shields with a math operation.

object_adjust_shield.description: Modifies an object's current shields with a math operation.

object_attach.description: Attaches one object to another with offset and constraint parameters.

object_bounce.description: Applies an upward impulse to an object.

object_destroy.description: Destroys an object immediately (distinct from `delete_object` in engine handling).

object_detach.description: Detaches a child object from its parent.

object_face_object.description: Rotates an object to face another object.

object_get_distance.description: Writes the distance between two objects into an out-variable.

object_get_health.description: Reads an object's current health into an out-variable.

object_get_orientation.description: Reads an object's orientation into an out-variable.

object_get_shield.description: Reads an object's current shields into an out-variable.

object_get_velocity.description: Reads an object's velocity into an out-variable.

object_set_invincibility.description: Sets whether an object can take damage.

object_set_minimap_icon.description: Megalo action `object_set_minimap_icon`. Minimap actions can be compiled for Alpha Halo: Reach builds, but no known Halo: Reach builds have a functioning Minimap menu rendering these functions useless.

object_set_minimap_priority.description: Megalo action `object_set_minimap_priority`. Minimap actions can be compiled for Alpha Halo: Reach builds, but no known Halo: Reach builds have a functioning Minimap menu rendering these functions useless.

object_set_minimap_visibility.description: Megalo action `object_set_minimap_visibility`. Minimap actions can be compiled for Alpha Halo: Reach builds, but no known Halo: Reach builds have a functioning Minimap menu rendering these functions useless.

object_set_never_garbage.description: Prevents the engine from garbage-collecting an object.

object_set_scale.description: Scales an object by a multiplier.

play_sound.description: Plays a sound for a team or player target. Sound tokens are listed in Sounds.

player_adjust_money.description: Modifies a player's requisition money with a math operation. `player_adjust_money` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

player_death_get_damage_type.description: Writes the damage type from a death event into an out-variable.

player_death_get_killing_player.description: Writes the killing player from a death event into an out-variable.

player_death_get_special_type.description: Writes the special death type (melee, headshot, etc.) into an out-variable.

player_enable_purchases.description: Enables or disables requisition purchases by category and alive/dead state. `player_enable_purchases` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

player_get_equipment.description: Reads a player's equipment into an out-variable.

player_get_fireteam_index.description: Reads or writes a player's fireteam index.

player_get_killing_spree_count.description: Reads a player's killstreak count into an out-variable.

player_get_place.description: Writes a player's scoreboard rank into an out-variable.

player_get_target_object.description: Reads a player's current target object into an out-variable.

player_get_vehicle.description: Writes the vehicle a player occupies into an out-variable.

player_get_weapon.description: Reads a player's current weapon into an out-variable.

player_pick_up_weapon.description: Forces a player to pick up a weapon object.

player_set_coop_spawning.description: Enables or disables cooperative spawning for a player.

player_set_fireteam_index.description: Assigns a player to a fireteam index.

player_set_objective_allegiance_icon.description: Sets the objective allegiance icon for a player. The icon is a constant integer (literal or number constant such as `k_engine_icon_elite`), in range `0`–`127`, or `-1` for none.

player_set_objective_allegiance.description: Sets objective allegiance text (friendly/enemy/neutral styling) using a dynamic string.

player_set_objective.description: Sets objective text shown to a player using a dynamic string.

player_set_primary_respawn_object.description: Sets a player's primary respawn object.

player_set_requisition_palette.description: Assigns a requisition palette to a player. `player_set_requisition_palette` is part of the Requisition System that was scrapped before Halo: Reach's release. While much of the requisition functionality remains in the game to this day, the requisition menu is long gone, rendering this action effectively useless outside of early pre-release builds.

player_set_unit.description: Megalo action `player_set_unit` with operands: player, object.

player_set_vehicle_spawning.description: Enables or disables vehicle spawning for a player.

player_set_vehicle.description: Forces a player into a vehicle reference.

print_variable.description: Prints a dynamic string to the debug log.

random.description: Writes a random integer into an out-variable between the configured minimum and maximum. The minimum is **inclusive**; the maximum is **exclusive** (for example, `action random 0 5 x` yields 0–4).

respawn_zone_enable.description: Enables or disables a respawn zone object.

saved_film_insert_marker.description: Inserts a marker into a saved film recording. The label operand is a dynamic string.

set_boundary.description: Configures boundary shape parameters on an object.

set_fireteam_respawn_filter.description: Restricts fireteam respawn permissions on an object.

set_loadout_palette.description: Assigns a loadout palette tier to a player or team. By default, the `loadout_selection_time` game option is set to zero. Using `set_loadout_palette` will set `loadout_selection_time`to 10 if: - You are not using the `base` element - ie. your script doesnt use `base "../file.mglo"` - You haven't set `loadout_selection_time` in your `game_options`.

set_pickup_filter.description: Restricts who can pick up an object (`all`, `allies`, `enemies`, `no_one`).

set_player_respawn_vehicle.description: Sets the respawn vehicle type for a player (Reach MCC only).

set_progress_bar.description: Configures an object's progress bar display.

set_respawn_filter.description: Restricts who can respawn at an object.

set_scenario_interpolator_state.description: Sets a scenario interpolator state index.

set_score.description: Modifies a player or team score using a math operation, a numeric value or variable reference, and a team or player target.

set_team_respawn_vehicle.description: Sets the respawn vehicle type for a team (Reach MCC only).

set.description: Modifies a variable using a math operation (`set_to`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `divide`, `modulo`, or `=`). The target can be a custom variable, member variable, or built-in global.

submit_incident_with_custom_value.description: Fires a game incident and passes a custom numeric value.

submit_incident.description: Fires a game incident with team or player target context for cause and effect (from `incidents.txt`).

team_get_place.description: Writes a team's scoreboard rank into an out-variable.

team_set_coop_spawning.description: Enables or disables cooperative spawning for a team.

team_set_primary_respawn_object.description: Sets a team's primary respawn object.

team_set_vehicle_spawning.description: Enables or disables vehicle spawning for a team (Reach MCC only).

timer_reset.description: Resets a timer to its initial value.

timer_set_rate.description: Sets a timer's tick rate. `0` pauses, `-1` counts down, `1` is normal speed.

weapon_set_pickup_priority.description: Sets weapon pickup priority for an object.
